caption: The drawing shows a single object centered on a light beige background, enclosed by a faint rectangular outline. The object consists of a handle at the top, which appears slightly rounded and colored in shades of brown with a hint of purple. Attached to the handle are three twisted metal rods that extend downward, merging into a continuous loop forming three rounded, open sections that resemble a clover or abstract floral shape. The lines of the object are rendered primarily in black, with some shading to suggest dimension, particularly on the handle and rods. There are a few small brownish stains on the background, particularly on the right side of the drawing. The overall composition is minimal, with the object being the sole focus and placed upright in the center of the image.
title: Toaster
